title: A merge that cannot name its feature must not sweep docs/knowledge either
action: Residual named by the kss-1 semantic judge (verdict PASS, so this is the last arm, not a repair of a failed truth). kss-1 scoped docs/knowledge to the merging feature's own recorded paths in the Some(feature) arm of main_bookkeeping_roots (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/merge.rs). The None arm — a merge that cannot resolve WHICH feature it is landing — still does roots.push("docs/knowledge") and sweeps every authored file under it. That is the exact 7429dfda incident shape, still reachable: a merge swallowing a sibling session's spec sync into its own bookkeeping commit, nothing lost but the authorship wrong. The decisive evidence is inside the same match arm: in that same None arm, docs/history is swept NOT AT ALL. The code already holds the rule "do not sweep an authored tree you cannot scope" for history, and takes the opposite default for knowledge two lines apart. The existing doc comment defends the None arm on the grounds that there is no data to SCOPE the sweep — which is an argument for not scoping it, never an argument for still TAKING it. FIX: the None arm drops docs/knowledge, exactly as it already drops docs/history. .bee and docs/decisions stay blanket in BOTH arms — they are machine-written, they are the deadlock the auto-commit exists to close, and nothing about them changes here. A knowledge file left dirty is then named by the EXISTING dirty-main refusal, the same path that already names an unscopable docs/history file today; that refusal is already built and already tested, and the instruction it gives (commit your own capture) is the honest one. Update the None arm's commit subject at phases.rs so it names what is actually swept and no longer claims docs/knowledge. Do NOT touch the Some arm kss-1 shipped, the worktree_merge_commit_bookkeeping opt-out, the refusal's message contract, or bee close's own .bee-only bookkeeping commit. Do NOT edit packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs — it is reserved by another session. TESTS: a feature-less merge with a dirty docs/knowledge file leaves it uncommitted and the dirty-main refusal names it; the same merge still sweeps .bee and docs/decisions; and the Some-arm tests kss-1 added all still pass unchanged. Mirror the existing feature-less docs/history assertions rather than inventing a new fixture style.
done_when: A merge that cannot resolve its feature sweeps .bee and docs/decisions and nothing under docs/knowledge; the dirty-main refusal names the untouched knowledge file; the None arm's commit subject matches what it sweeps; the Some arm, the opt-out, the refusal contract, and bee close's bookkeeping commit are all unchanged; close.rs is untouched; and the worktree suite is green.
notes: Phase 2, the last arm of the sweep. Judge evidence: in the same None arm, docs/history is already not swept.
